Name: Sambastian Romance
Author: crunchkitty
Description:
For all the SamSeb shippers out there: this mod makes Sam and Sebastian a couple!

It adds/edits dialogue from the two of them and others to reflect their relationship. Cutscenes up to 8 hearts are edited to be platonic with the player character and reference their relationship. All references to romantic relationships with other NPCs, i.e. Abigail/Sebastian, are removed.

Both of them remain romanceable, but given that the one you don't romance will still act like he's in a relationship, I suggest you just uninstall the mod if you choose to romance either of them.

On rainy days, there's a 50% chance to see a surprise! Follow Sebastian around and see what happens ;)
[u]
Installation Requirements:[/u] SMAPI and Content Patcher. Follow the standard installation procedure for CP.

This mod has not been tested on Mac/Linux.
